generate_translations: generate translations of a source sentence using SequenceGenerator with beam search and nucleus sampling
apply_repetition_penalties: apply repetition penalties to log probabilities using alpha_presence and alpha_frequency parameters
sample_topp_nucleus: sample tokens using top-P nucleus sampling with optional factual decay via lambda_decay
ensemble_model_forward_decoder: forward pass through an ensemble of models using EnsembleModel forward_decoder method
generate_with_alignment: generate translations with source-target alignments using SequenceGeneratorWithAlignment class
